liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Definitive Jerry Garcia guitar performance; melodic loops nailed [23]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Performance described as oozing with midi effects [21]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Magnificent performance with strong vocals; minor feedback at start [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Queen Jane Approximately**: cut on the recording [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-07-12.AKG451.Currier.Keo.121537.Flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1990-07-12.143602.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 189 min [6]
- **gd1990-07-12.149730.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [7]
- **gd1990-07-12.161266.mtx.seamons.ht154.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 177 min [10]. Said about its sound: SBD sounds good overall; set 1 DAT levels lower than set 2; Jerry's guitar low in mix during Stranger and Bertha [10]
- **gd90-07-12.sbd.mcatee.2582.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 177 min; rated 4.53/5 by 66 [15]. Said about its sound: Mix balances crowd noise and rain for listening experience [17]

## Around the show

- Rainstorm during performance; crowd enthusiasm audible in recording [17]
- Relentless rain throughout the show [19]
- Brent's final Dark Star performance noted as a notable moment [20]
- Crowd energy soaked in rain; band played with old energy [24]
- High heat and humidity before first set rainstorm [26]
- Edie Brickell made cryptic reference before rain started [27]
- Thunder cracked alongside Jerry's guitar during Bertha rain [28]
- Edie Brickell & New Bohemians opened the show [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-07-12.AKG451.Currier.Keo.121537.Flac1644**: taped by Mr. Currier; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Currier, Transfer By Keo; AKGC451EB/CK1's>AKG 9V Phantom Power>Marantz PDM 430> Probaly Dolby (Not Marked)>Tapes Maxell… [1]
- **gd1990-07-12.143602.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Dave Brotman; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Dave Brotman Master DAT Recording: (FOB) Schoeps CMC3/MK2S (spaced) > Oade Pre-Amp > Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k) [6]
- **gd1990-07-12.149730.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 12, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [7]
- **gd1990-07-12.161266.mtx.seamons.ht154.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Soundtrack Pro and Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Soundtrack & Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT… [10]
- **gd90-07-12.sbd.mcatee.2582.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > DAT clones > ZA-2 > wave (via Cool Edit) > CD-R [15]
- Video recorded and provided by Brokedown House Production [30]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-07-12 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-07-12-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [34]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-07-12 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-07-12-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [35]
